# Module M-02: Handle an email with no readable purchase order

## Lesson

You do this when an email's attachment is an image, not a PDF. When it works, the email is on the exceptions list with the reason, and nothing from it is in the order sheet. [SC-02]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the orders mailbox and find the email with an image attached. [SC-02 step 1]
2. Open the exceptions list and check the email's line is there, not in the order sheet. [SC-02 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

Ask the customer to send the purchase order again as a PDF. [map/future.md item 1]
